## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra (T601) is Dānapāla's 施護 ([施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)) Northern Song translation of a late expansion of the *Sāgara-nāgarāja-paripṛcchā* cycle. *Suōjiāluó* 娑伽羅 is the standard Song-period transcription of *Sāgara*.

**Abstract**

A short Northern-Song Mahāyāna sūtra — bodhisattva-path doctrine framed as instruction to the Sea-Nāga king Sāgara — datable to Dānapāla's translation activity at the imperial Yìjīng-yuàn / Chuán-fǎ-yuàn (980–1017 CE). The text supplements the older Dharmarakṣa version [KR6i0232](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0232) *Hǎi-lóngwáng jīng* (T598) and the Yìjìng excerpt [KR6i0233](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0233) *Fǎyìn jīng* (T599).
